component.name: Lamplight
component.summary: Set keyboard RGB colors and effects

description.p: Lamplight controls the RGB lighting of keyboards and devices that support Windows Dynamic Lighting (HID LampArray), such as recent ASUS Vivobook laptops.

ul.li: Solid color, accent color, breathing, color cycle, rainbow, wave, wheel and gradient effects
Brightness, speed and direction controls with a live preview
Lights turn off with the screen and come back after suspend
A background service keeps effects running after the app closes

description.p: The GNOME extension works on its own: install it from extensions.gnome.org and set up keyboard access with one click.
The brightness slider stays in sync with the laptop's keyboard backlight keys and GNOME's keyboard brightness.
Colors closer to the screen: gamma correction and white-balance calibration. The Quick Settings menu scrolls instead of running off small screens.
Install only the parts you need, software center metadata, and documentation updates.
